test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As of May 2025, former cricketer Harbhajan Singh represents which political party in the Rajya Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aam Aadmi Party**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Harbhajan Singh**, a former Indian cricketer, has transitioned into politics and represents the **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)** in the **Rajya Sabha** as of **May 2025**.
 
• **Harbhajan Singh** was nominated by the **Aam Aadmi Party** for his contributions to public welfare and his influence as a public figure.
 
• The **Aam Aadmi Party**, led by **Arvind Kejriwal**, primarily focuses on governance reforms, anti-corruption measures, and public welfare policies, which resonated with Harbhajan Singh's vision of serving the public.
 
• The **Rajya Sabha**, also known as the Upper House of Parliament in India, is where Harbhajan Singh represents his state and contributes to national-level policymaking.
 
• The **Aam Aadmi Party** has been actively expanding its political presence across India and seeks to bring individuals from diverse backgrounds, including sports, into governance roles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP):**

 
 
• The **Aam Aadmi Party** was founded in **November 2012** by **Arvind Kejriwal** and others, following the India Against Corruption movement.
 
• The party aims to promote **transparency, accountability, and anti-corruption measures** in governance.
 
• It has been particularly successful in **Delhi**, forming the government multiple times, and has been expanding its reach to other states like **Punjab**.
 
• The party emphasizes education, health, electricity, and water reforms as part of its governance model.
 
• It is recognized for its innovative policy initiatives and grassroots-level engagement with citizens.
 
 
 
• **Harbhajan Singh:**
 
 
• Born on **3 July 1980**, Harbhajan Singh is one of India's most successful cricketers, known for his exceptional skills as an off-spinner.
 
• He has represented India in **103 Test matches, 236 ODIs, and 28 T20Is**, securing numerous accolades throughout his cricket career.
 
• After retiring from international cricket, Harbhajan Singh ventured into politics to contribute to social welfare and development.
 
• His association with the **Aam Aadmi Party** reflects his interest in public service and governance.
 
 
 
• **Rajya Sabha:**
 
 
• The **Rajya Sabha**, or Council of States, is the **Upper House of India's Parliament**.
 
• It consists of **250 members**, with representatives elected by the legislative assemblies of states and union territories.
 
• The Rajya Sabha plays a crucial role in reviewing legislation and representing the interests of states at the national level.
 
• Members serve for a term of **6 years**, with one-third of the body retiring every two years.
 
 
 
• **Other Political Parties in India:**
 
 
• **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP):** India’s ruling party since 2014, known for its focus on nationalism, economic reforms, and development initiatives.
 
• **Indian National Congress (INC):** One of India’s oldest political parties, traditionally known for its focus on secularism and social justice.
 
• **Shiromani Akali Dal (Badal):** A regional party mainly active in Punjab, focusing on Sikh issues and agricultural policies.
 
• India has a multi-party system with national and regional parties representing diverse ideologies and agendas.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Political Representation:**

 
 
• Sports personalities like Harbhajan Singh entering politics signify the increasing diversity in political representation in India.
 
• Such individuals bring a unique perspective and connect with youth and communities through their fame and achievements.
 
 
 
• **Role of Rajya Sabha:**
 
 
• The Rajya Sabha ensures state-level interests are represented at the national level and plays a crucial role in legislative processes.
 
• Members like Harbhajan Singh contribute to the legislative discussions and policymaking, ensuring a broader range of perspectives.
